data.title: Philadelphia Union beat Chicago Fire 3-1 for 8th straight victory during 14-match unbeaten streak - Chicago Tribune
data.content: Soccer |   Philadelphia Union beat Chicago Fire 3-1 for…. # Philadelphia Union beat Chicago Fire 3-1 for 8th straight victory during 14-match unbeaten streak. Bruno Damiani netted two goals after Milan Iloski scored — all with a man advantage — and Cavan Sullivan set a record for teenagers as the Philadelphia Union beat the Chicago Fire 3-1 on Wednesday at Soldier Field for their eighth straight victory in a club-record 14-match unbeaten streak. Sullivan, who turned 17 this season, picked up his 14th assist on Damiani’s first goal to set a league record for teens with 21 goal contributions this season. Maren Haile-Selassie staked Chicago (14-9-6) to a 1-0 halftime lead with a goal in the 44th minute, but defender Jack Elliott was tagged with a yellow card in the 41st minute and again in the first minute of stoppage time, leaving the Fire a man down from there with his red-card exit. The Fire beat the Union 2-1 on the road to close out March.
